trust_decision.summary: Report parameters taken straight from $_POST['PARAM_n'] (or $_GET via prn_redirect) are trusted as SQL fragments in unquoted numeric/list positions; the fix decides they must go through db_escape() at each query-building site (gl_db_trans.inc, rep601.php, rep710.php).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names get_gl_transactions(); its only raw concatenation is the $filter_type IN (...) clause.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: reporting/rep601.php:87 and reporting/rep710.php:45-47 — separate inline report queries that never call get_gl_transactions() (gl/includes/db/gl_db_trans.inc:106)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names get_gl_transactions(); the bank-statement and audit-trail reports build their own SQL against other tables and are not on that function's call path, so a solver can call them unrelated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: rep702 'All' type selection (-1 mapped to null, so the IN filter is skipped) and rep601 'All accounts' (ALL_TEXT skips the WHERE) must keep working; also the IN(...) position accepts a comma list by construction, which quoting via db_escape collapses to a single value, and over-broad intval/is_numeric rejection would break the -1/ALL_TEXT sentinels

O6_input_shapes: single scalar type id in IN(...) list position (gl_db_trans.inc)
unquoted numeric id (rep601 id, rep710 a.type)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GL account inquiry passes $_POST['account'] into get_gl_balance_from_to(), which interpolates '$account' without db_escape in the same gl_trans sink file (quotes are pre-encoded by global html_cleanup, so exploitability is unverified)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Value is quoted and $_POST is html_cleanup'd (includes/session.inc:487-490), so a solver can argue it is not injectable and not part of get_gl_transactions()
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; caller gl/inquiry/gl_account_inquiry.php:162

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GL budget entry passes $_POST['account'] into get_gl_trans_from_to(), same unescaped '$account' pattern
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above: quoted position plus global html_cleanup; budget screen is a neighbouring feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; caller gl/gl_budget.php:118

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GL account transactions report could forward a type filter PARAM to get_gl_transactions() filter_type position as a comma list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: get_gl_transactions already exposes $filter_type as a raw IN(...) list and rep702 is the template; a multi-type filter is a natural feature request

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Bank statement w/reconcile could build its account query inline like rep601 (WHERE id = $acc) instead of calling get_bank_account()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: rep602 is a near copy of rep601 and the two diverged only in this lookup

O8b_injection_room.sibling: list helper with raw 'WHERE type=$type' could be fed a report/inquiry filter parameter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same unquoted-type idiom already exists in UI combo builders

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89) via unescaped report/filter parameters in hand-built MySQL queries
